summary: Fast Track Group, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, reported in Form 6-K the results of an extraordinary general meeting held August 17, 2026. Shareholders approved a 1-for-20 reverse share split of ordinary shares, reducing authorized shares from 50 million to 2.5 million, and redesignating the post-split shares into Class A and Class B ordinary shares. All proposals passed with overwhelming support, with votes for exceeding 99.8%. The filing is routine corporate governance and capital structure maintenance, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or strategic change were involved; the reverse split is a technical adjustment with no direct market or M&A implications.
